cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection is the biggest threat to children's wellbeing, not technology itself. The solution lies in spending more time talking openly with children rather than worrying about screen time.

cards.title: Halloween at Every Stage: Safety and Connection
cards.body: Make Halloween fun and meaningful while prioritizing child safety. Help your children build confidence and create lasting memories through thoughtful planning.

cards.title: Managing Anger: Teaching Kids Emotional Regulation
cards.body: Parents struggle with asking children to control anger when they themselves struggle with it. Understanding what we're really asking of our kids requires honest self-reflection.

cards.title: Outgrowing Holiday Traditions: Balancing Closeness
cards.body: When children grow up, family traditions need flexibility and conversation to stay meaningful. Letting kids have autonomy while staying connected requires intentional effort from parents.

cards.title: Toxic Relatives: Drawing Boundaries for Your Kids
cards.body: Parents must decide how much time their children spend with dysfunctional family members. Specific questions can help you navigate these difficult decisions thoughtfully.

cards.title: Bilingual Children: How Kids Adapt Between Languages
cards.body: Heritage speakers don't simply lose language skills—they adapt and switch between their languages strategically. Recent research challenges outdated views about bilingual language development.

cards.title: Music Lessons: Unpacking Parental Expectations
cards.body: Behind music lessons lies a complex web of parental regret, social admiration, and idealized self-images. Understanding these motivations can help parents make better decisions for their children.

cards.title: Why Children Say 'Na-Na-Na': Readers Explain
cards.body: Readers share their perspectives on why childhood taunts like 'na-na-na-na' are so universally annoying. This age-old behavior reveals something about child psychology and peer dynamics.

cards.title: Kindness After Loss: Community Support for Grieving Families
cards.body: A football club's extraordinary gesture of sending a care package to a boy years after he stopped playing shows the power of community compassion. Small acts of kindness can deeply comfort grieving families.
